desc: Derive and verify pair-state BFS transitions, base cases, and correctness for even- and odd-length palindromes.
Design efficient grouped incoming/outgoing adjacency structures and practical transition enumeration for Python at N=100.
Analyze worst-case time and memory complexity, especially dense graphs with many equal labels.
Implement multi-source BFS with zero-length diagonal and one-edge initial states.
Output the N × N distance matrix with -1 for unreachable pairs.
